import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# In obs_0055: cam pos (-1.62, 1.65), heading = 315 deg
img55 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0055.png')

blue55 = (img55[:,:,0] > 150) & (img55[:,:,2] < 50)
